root_causes.description: The checkout container was killed by a deployment spec change ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted'). Its replacement pod cannot start because the sandbox image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fails to pull (DeadlineExceeded → ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff), leaving checkout in a crash-loop back-off and unable to serve any traffic.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=1)
evidence.expected_baseline: no container kill/restart events for a healthy pod

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a (count=2)
evidence.expected_baseline: sandbox image pulled successfully, no pull failures
healthy checkout serves a continuous multi-req/s stream

evidence.observed_value: 0 checkout server spans emitted during window

root_causes.description: Frontend error rate spiked because it calls checkout, which is unavailable; this is downstream propagation of the checkout outage, not an independent frontend fault.

evidence.expected_baseline: frontend error_rate near 0 when checkout is healthy

root_causes.description: Residual suspicion that the sandbox image pull failure stems from node registry/network issues (gcr.io DeadlineExceeded); however, the dominant observable is the checkout pod crash-loop, so the image-pull path is treated as the recovery blocker rather than a separate root cause.

evidence.observed_value: count=4 back-offs on sandbox image pull

remediation_steps: Roll back the checkout Deployment to the previous working container definition — the event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' shows a recent spec change triggered the kill.

Fix the sandbox image pull failure: pulls of gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest fail with DeadlineExceeded — verify registry/DNS connectivity, use an accessible mirror or pre-seed the pause image on the node, or set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent.
Restart/recreate the checkout pod once the image pull path is restored so it leaves ImagePullBackOff and becomes Ready.
Verify checkout request_rate and frontend error_rate return to baseline after recovery.
